'''Red Squadron''' was a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that fought at the [[Attacks on Platform NL-1|Second Battle of the Pakuuni system]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. It was destroyed by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
